name: done-means-done
implementation: Consolidated protocol and newly integrated Python runtime based on the inspected source design. Not a byte-identical upstream checkout; baseline source was read through the GitHub connector. 0.4.0 additionally diverges from the inspected commit with locally reviewed defect fixes (acceptance-basis attestation, state-path canonicalization, background-holder execution, record supersession, history append, approval and listing diagnostics) that were not upstreamed. 0.4.1 adds bounded lock retry, tolerant bookkeeping hooks and sibling-worktree diagnostics. 0.5.0 binds evidence to each check's own candidate tree, diffs drift into a STALE result, runs a check list in one fingerprint window, refuses concurrent writers before running, serializes named resources across tasks, adds per-group listing, and makes recovery inspect the runner. No remote repository writes performed. 0.5.1 keeps pre-0.5.0 worktree receipts accepted while the task root is unchanged, names the cause in every gate reason, groups the gate into a headline with the rerun command, repeats that in the Stop hook, and reports run progress on stderr. 0.5.2 makes hooks report no task, silently and with exit 0, when the host cwd is outside any Git checkout or no longer exists, instead of failing SessionStart with a DMD_STATE containment error. 0.6.0 makes hooks fail open, isolates sessions across projects, adds operator deferral, doctor, gc and relocate. 0.7.0 evaluates each task once (one Assessment behind gate, next, summary and hooks), makes BLOCKED mean nothing is actionable, keeps a stored COMPLETE final for hooks, releases a no-progress stop instead of pausing the task, survives a killed runner, treats a file that never settles as drift, makes work items optional, and requires an executed check to disprove a confirmed finding. 0.7.1 stops lookups from creating empty record directories, prunes existing ones in gc, and routes all evidence through standard input so nothing is written into the state root by hand. 0.8.0 hardens the trust boundaries from an adversarial audit: verifier approval and every contract-changing record require an operator-confirmed decision (host prompt or bounded /dev/tty), installed hooks default to enforce with UserPromptSubmit capture and Edit/Write-aware matchers, request provenance is host-captured where the prompt channel exists, anchors must quote the request, blockers need evidence artifacts, confirmed duplicates need shared executed evidence, --writes no longer excludes generated outputs from fingerprints, failed runs record attempts automatically, and pre-0.8.0 receipts must be reapproved and rerun.
